{{Quote|CT-1155. Skifter, if you prefer.|Skifter, introducing himself|<ref name="EGTW AC" />}}
'''Skifter''', further identified as '''CT-1155''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunship]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] who fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the battle, he was responsible for transporting multiple [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of clone troopers to the battlefield.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I didn't know I'd be behind the stick of a larty until we were en route from Big Stormy.|Skifter, finding out his role in the First Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="EGTW AC" />}}
Born on the [[Waterworld/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="SWE" /> CT-1155 was trained from birth to become a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. While inside of his [[cloning tank]], CT-1155 went through thousands of simulations and learned to fly and operate a wide array of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and vehicles, including the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] which he had a particular disdain for. CT-1155 eventually adopted the name Skifter,<ref name="EGTW AC" /> which was also a [[Skifter/Legends|means of cheating]] at the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card game.<ref name="Lady Luck">{{Tales|3|Lady Luck (comic story)}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], following the capture of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], an army of 190,000 clone troopers were dispatched to the rocky world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to help stop the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance's]] efforts on the planet.<ref name="ITW:AOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Following this massive deployment of clone forces, Skifter was sent to Geonosis aboard an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]], where he was assigned to pilot an LAAT/i gunship alongside another pilot by the name of [[Ronto (clone trooper)|Ronto]].<ref name="EGTW AC" />

[[File:Im-g-twe_Hills.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Skifter flew through the Im'g'twe Hills during the Battle of Geonosis.]]
Upon entering the atmosphere of Geonosis, Skifter began his transport run and broke off from his ''Acclamator'', heading towards the drop zone located past the [[Im'g'twe Hills/Legends|Im'g'twe Hills]]. His ship; however, instantly came under fire as a group of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] began their assault. Making his way through the Im'g'twe Hills, Skifter's copilot managed to take out a couple of fighters, which allowed the LAAT/i to safely land with only slight damage to its back quarter. While he began unloading a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of clone troopers, Skifter could feel his [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] jumping, as he felt like every [[Missile/Legends|missile]], [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was aimed at him. Once he got the all clear, Skifter headed back to his ''Acclamator ''to load up more troops onto his gunship. Skifter would keep unloading platoons of clone troopers all day, to a point where he couldn't remember how many troops he had dropped off.<ref name="EGTW AC" />

Once Skifter had returned to his ''Acclamator'', he had trouble getting his [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] off, as his back, legs and rear were killing him from his constant transport runs. As soon as he laid down in his bunks, Skifter immediately fell asleep, noting that it felt like being hit with a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast. Waking up the next morning to the sound of the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], Skifter realized that the battle on Geonosis was only the beginning to a much larger war.<ref name="EGTW AC" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bounty hunter Jango Fett, Skifter stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="SWE" /> Being a clone pilot during the [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase 1]] era of the Clone Wars, Skifter wore specialized clone trooper armor outfitted with a special box, located on the chest plate, that fed [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] directly into his helmet. Skifter's armor, like most other clone pilots during the First Battle of Geonosis, featured [[Color/Legends|yellow]] markings along with two red [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] symbols located atop his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="SWE2">{{Film|II}}</ref> During his time in the cloning tanks of Kamino, which he referred to as "Big Stormy", Skifter showed disdain towards the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] as he disliked the [[Walker/Legends|walker's]] lack of maneuverability.<ref name="EGTW AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I liked this slice of Grand Army life, but it felt a bit too similar to the first-person account "Clone Trooper Falls in a Hole&hellip;" That one made the book; with space at a premium, this one didn't.|Jason Fry explains why ''A Soldier's Story: I was a Gunship Pilot'' was cut from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''|<ref name="EGTW AC" />}}
Originally created by [[Jason Fry]] for [[The Essential Guide to Warfare]], Skifter was supposed to appear in the short story ''A Soldier's Story: I was a Gunship Pilot''. Although, due to the story's similarities with ''Clone Trooper Falls in a Hole&hellip;'', and a lack of space in the book for it, Skifter was cut from The Essential Guide to Warfare alongside his short-story. Two years later, on [[May 6]]th [[2014]], Jason Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] published a twelve-part [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog]] series named ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' that brought back many of the cut stories from the original book. In the eight part of the blog, entitled ''Tales of the Clone Wars'', Skifter's story was brought back with commentary from both Jason Fry and Erich Schoeneweiss.<ref name="EGTW AC" />
